about: What the Bible import, the book-name and lyric tools know of ENGLISH: its stop words, the English names that mean English, and that Latin letters name no one locale. Every other language's facts -- its scripts and locales, the names it goes by in English and in its own words, its little words, letters and marks -- are in its own folder (`online/<code>/world.json`) and come with that language installed (`tools/owa-devtools-mcp/worldLanguages.mjs`).
